title: HUANUO Glass Standing Desk with Drawers, 35 X 20 Inch Electric Adjustable Height Desk, Quick Install One-Piece Tabletop with USB Charging Ports, White Review
reviews: Easy assembly and pleasant experience This was one of the easiest desks that I have put together! I literally took me less than 20 minutes. The instructions were clear and the parts all lined up where they needed to be. It is very sturdy in every position you put it in. The actual desk is awesome too! I looove being able to write my daily tasks on it and then just erase it. I can say good bye to the messy looking post it notes I used to have everywhere. The drawer fits all my essentials and the desk even though it is small, I have everything I need on it. I love being able to stand up when my back hurts and keep working. Overall great value for money!

Get it! I’m obsessed with the quality and the look of this desk. Easy assembly, sturdy, and you get exactly what you paid for. It looks exactly like the photos. The packaging was super protective. It’s better than I imagined.
Very cool It’s easy to install and work good as expected
Love the glass top Easy set up, very nice and esthetically please when displayed. Very easy to work from, I should have gig a little wider top but the length would fit in the bay window.

Super nice! This desk is super nice, was easy to assemble, and it fits perfectly in the small spot where I needed it to go. I have my work laptop docked on it with 2 monitors on a monitor stand and plenty of room for my wireless keyboard, mouse, drinks, and notes.
Amazing! This desk is stable and beautiful! I have only had it a few days, but really pleased with the purchase! You will love the high quality!
Amazing ! I got the 35 x20 and it’s perfect size!! Took about 30 mins to install!! Directions were clear! It works exactly like the description.

Outstanding Quality The whole experience, from opening the carton to putting the desk in its intended place was just great. The packaging was intelligent and there wasn't a single mark on any piece. It went together so easily, even the electrical connections. The directions were absolutely clear and I didn't make even one mistake putting it together. It's pretty heavy (ALL METAL!) and won't tip over or break easily. If I needed two of these, I'd buy another one today.
